scripts.start: npm --prefix client install && uv sync --directory server && uv sync --directory cli
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: uv run --directory server pytest && uv run --directory cli pytest
scripts.lint: uv run --directory server ruff check . && uv run --directory cli ruff check . && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory server pyright && uv run --directory cli pyright && npm --prefix client run typecheck
